update_log: Baseline initialization of high-frequency data regarding the number of players in various sports (per side/team) for Sports Static GK.

major_field_sports.key_fact: A standard team consists of 11 players on the field. A 12th man acts as a substitute fielder but cannot bowl, bat, or keep wicket.
Played with 10 field players and 1 goalkeeper.
Has the highest number of players per team among major field sports. (Note: Rugby League is a different variant played with 13 players).
Nine players take the field on defense (pitcher, catcher, four infielders, three outfielders).

court_and_indoor_sports.key_fact: Played with 5 players on the court per team at a time.
Six players on the court per team, separated by a high net.
Consists of 6 outfield players and 1 goalkeeper.
A non-contact sport featuring 7 players per team, each with specifically assigned positions and restricted court zones.
Consists of 5 skaters and 1 goaltender on the ice per team.

traditional_and_water_sports.key_fact: Played with 7 players on the mat per team. A bonus point is uniquely available to the raider if the defending team has 6 or more players on the mat.
A traditional Indian tag game. A team consists of 12 players, but only 9 take the field during play.
Played on horseback with 4 players per team.
Consists of 6 field players and 1 goalkeeper treading in the water.
Two teams of 8 members each pull on opposite ends of a heavy rope.

racket_and_table_sports.key_fact: These sports are played either individually against one opponent (Singles) or in pairs against another pair (Doubles).
